IC1: Age of 18 and over, male [OR] or female;
IC2: Patients with histologically confirmed advanced (stage IV) gastric cancer [OR], NSCLC [OR], breast cancer [OR] or ovarian cancer, who choose monotherapy [AND] of oral vascular targeting drug (apatinib) due to intolerability or inappropriateness of other therapies;
IC3: Presence of measurable lesions [AND] (=10mm on spiral CT scan) subject to RECIST 1.1;
IC4: Blood pressured controlled at 150/100 mHg following drug administration;
IC5: An ECOG PS score of between 0 and 1;
IC6: A life expectancy of at least 3 months;
IC7: Subjects who volunteer to participate in this study and have signed the Informed Consent Form (ICF), with good compliance with treatment and follow-up.
